assets.purpose: A progression from R setup and fundamentals through data structures, data workflows, statistics, applications and professional practice.
assets.alt_text: Learning roadmap showing a beginner-to-advanced sequence with an optional specialist branch.
assets.caption: Follow the core route first; specialist topics can be selected when relevant.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Comparison of common R structures by purpose and organization.
assets.alt_text: Vectors and matrices hold one atomic type; lists can hold mixed objects; data frames organize same-length columns; factors represent categories.
assets.caption: Choose by semantics and shape, not only by convenience.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: A synthetic dataset moves through type checks, missingness review, duplicate checks, and documented transformations.
assets.alt_text: Raw synthetic rows are validated for types, missing values, duplicates and inconsistent categories before producing a clean analytical table.
assets.caption: Keep an audit trail of every cleaning decision.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: A responsible analysis goes from a question to design, estimation, diagnostics and communication.
assets.alt_text: The diagram links research question, sampling/design, method assumptions, estimate/uncertainty, diagnostic checks and careful interpretation.
assets.caption: A p-value or fitted model is not a substitute for study design and interpretation.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: A labelled SVG scatterplot uses illustrative, invented values to demonstrate association.
assets.alt_text: Scatterplot of synthetic study-hour and quiz-score values with axes and caption; the pattern suggests association but does not establish cause.
assets.caption: All values are synthetic for instruction; no external dataset is used.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.
assets.source_data: Synthetic points: study_hours=[1,1.5,2,2.8,3.5,4,4.8,5.6]; quiz_score=[61,66,64,74,77,72,85,88]. The drawing positions are illustrative; the values are invented for this course.

assets.purpose: A labelled 2 by 2 matrix relates predicted classes to actual classes and supports performance metrics.
assets.alt_text: Matrix shows true positive, false positive, false negative and true negative cell meanings.
assets.caption: Metric choice depends on the consequences of errors and the class balance.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.
assets.source_data: Synthetic cells: TN=53, FP=5, FN=8, TP=34. Counts are illustrative, not a model evaluation result.

assets.purpose: The cycle connects validated input, reactive calculation, output rendering and user feedback.
assets.alt_text: A reactive input changes a calculation and re-renders outputs; validation and error states are part of the cycle.
assets.caption: Test empty inputs, invalid values and slow or failed operations.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: An R package moves from source and metadata to tests, checks, documentation and a versioned release.
assets.alt_text: Package development flow passes through metadata/dependencies, source functions, examples/tests, R CMD check and release review.
assets.caption: Do not publish until package checks and dependency review are complete.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.
